# ESG-Consistent Investment and Idiosyncratic Risk: The Roles of Information Asymmetry and Information Acquisition

**Authors:** Fang, Wang & Li  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Journal of Business Ethics  
**DOI:** [10.1007/s10551-023-11434-0](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10551-023-11434-0)

## Abstract

Examines how ESG-consistent investment affects idiosyncratic risk through information asymmetry and information acquisition channels.
